key_catalyst: Escalating semiconductor selloff on China's advancing domestic chipmaking-equipment capabilities
reasoning: The China chipmaking-equipment threat is a familiar theme that escalated rather than faded: it first hit on 2026-07-28 (QQQ -0.97%) and today intensified into an outright semiconductor crash (Micron -8.9%, AMD -8.1%, Applied Materials -7.8%), driving QQQ -1.41% even as the Dow rose ~1% and the S&P gained. The accelerating rotation out of AI/tech mega-caps into cyclicals is QQQ-specific downside that is still developing, not absorbed, and it sits directly ahead of two binary overnight catalysts.
